title: Preserving Anatomical Continuity: Three-Stage Pipeline for Colon Segmentation in 3D Abdominal CT Scans
abstract: arXiv:2610.03467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate colon segmentation from CT images is essential for colorectal disease analysis, yet deep learning based methods often produce disconnected predictions due to complex anatomy. This study introduces a three-stage, topology-preserving segmentation pipeline to address this issue. The first stage performs initial deep learning-based segmentation, followed by centreline bridging to reconnect disjoint regions and a reconstruction stage to refine continuity. Evaluations on TotalSegmentator and RAOS datasets using overlap, distance and topology-based metrics demonstrate improved structural consistency while maintaining segmentation accuracy. The proposed method enhances topological integrity, enabling more reliable colon segmentation for clinical and research applications.

translated_title: 保持解剖连续性：三维腹部CT扫描中结肠分割的三阶段流水线
translated_abstract: 从CT图像中准确分割结肠对于结直肠疾病分析至关重要，然而基于深度学习的方法由于复杂的解剖结构，常常产生不连通的预测结果。本研究提出了一种三阶段的保持拓扑结构的分割流水线来解决这一问题。第一阶段执行初始的基于深度学习的分割，随后通过中心线桥接重新连接不连续的区域，最后通过重建阶段来完善连续性。在TotalSegmentator和RAOS数据集上，使用重叠度、距离和基于拓扑的指标进行评估，结果表明该方法在保持分割精度的同时提高了结构一致性。所提出的方法增强了拓扑完整性，使结肠分割在临床和研究应用中更加可靠。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种三阶段的保持拓扑结构的结肠分割流水线，通过初始深度学习分割、中心线桥接和重建三个阶段，解决了CT图像结肠分割中预测结果不连通的问题，在保持分割精度的同时显著提高了结构一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-stage topology-preserving pipeline for colon segmentation in 3D abdominal CT scans, which addresses disconnected prediction issues through initial deep learning segmentation, centreline bridging, and reconstruction, achieving improved structural consistency while maintaining segmentation accuracy.
